lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a grid-like pattern on the lateral flank posterior to the branchial region. The spots are organized into roughly vertical columns with inter-spot distances approximately twice the diameter of the individual centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form structural grid nodes across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-luminance upper edges to shaded lower boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, thin, elongated feature is visible trailing from the ventral-lateral region near the base of the pectoral fin.
